title: SpaceX wins $1.6 billion in launch orders for military satellite networks
excerpt: SpaceX wins $1.6 billion in launch orders for military satellite networks SpaceX wins $1.6 billion in launch orders for military satellite networks
content_html:
WASHINGTON — The U.S. Space Force awarded SpaceX two launch task orders worth $1.6 billion to deploy military satellite constellations, marking the largest publicly announced batch of missions yet under the National Security Space Launch Phase 3 program.

The award covers 18 Falcon 9 launches from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California through the end of 2027 in support of the Space Based Sensing and Targeting portfolio, a collection of satellite programs intended to improve how the military detects, tracks and communicates information about threats in near real time.

The task orders reinforce SpaceX’s central role in the military’s next-generation satellite networks. Beyond providing the launches, the company is building two of the portfolio’s largest satellite systems under separate multibillion-dollar contracts, giving it responsibility for both placing the constellations in orbit and supplying key elements of the architecture itself.

Space Based Sensing and Targeting is one of the Space Force’s newly established acquisition portfolios. It oversees the Space Development Agency’s Tracking Layer, a constellation of infrared satellites designed to detect and track advanced missile threats; the Space Data Network Backbone, an optically linked communications network being built by SpaceX to move large volumes of military data across the Joint Force; and the Space-Based Airborne Moving Target Indicator program, another SpaceX-led constellation intended to track aircraft and other airborne targets from orbit.

SpaceX previously received contracts worth $2.29 billion for the Space Data Network Backbone and $4.16 billion for the Airborne Moving Target Indicator system.

The launch award is the largest publicly disclosed order under National Security Space Launch Phase 3 Lane 1, the Space Force’s commercial-style procurement program for lower-risk national security missions that allows pre-qualified providers to compete for individual launch orders without completing the military’s most demanding certification process.

The contract also follows the Space Force’s decision earlier this month to raise the Phase 3 Lane 1 contract ceiling to $17 billion from $5.6 billion, reflecting expectations that military launch demand will grow substantially faster than originally anticipated.

The schedule itself is notable. Completing 18 launches by the end of 2027 will require a sustained campaign averaging roughly one mission a month from Vandenberg, depending on the timing of satellite deliveries.

That cadence also highlights the gap between the number of companies eligible to compete for national security launches and those capable of executing them today.

Seven companies currently hold positions on the Lane 1 contract vehicle. For now, SpaceX remains the only company with the combination of launch frequency, operational Falcon 9 rockets and West Coast infrastructure needed to support a campaign of this scale.

Col. Eric Zarybnisky, the Space Force’s acting portfolio acquisition executive for space access, said the awards also demonstrate how quickly the Lane 1 contracting approach can move. He said the service completed the procurement in roughly two months from identifying the requirement to making the award, including a month for industry to prepare proposals.

content_html_zh:
华盛顿——美国太空军向 SpaceX 授予了两项价值 16 亿美元的发射任务订单，用于部署军用卫星星座，这是国家安全太空发射第三阶段计划中迄今为止公开宣布的最大一批任务。

该奖项涵盖截至 2027 年底从加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地发射的 18 次猎鹰 9 号火箭，以支持天基传感和目标组合，这是一系列卫星项目，旨在改善军方近乎实时地检测、跟踪和传达威胁信息的方式。

这些任务订单强化了 SpaceX 在军方下一代卫星网络中的核心作用。 除了提供发射服务外，该公司还根据价值数十亿美元的单独合同建造该组合​​中最大的两个卫星系统，负责将星座送入轨道并提供架构本身的关键元件。

天基传感和瞄准是太空军新建立的采购组合之一。 它负责监督太空发展局的跟踪层，这是一个旨在检测和跟踪先进导弹威胁的红外卫星星座；空间数据网络骨干网，这是一个由 SpaceX 建造的光学连接通信网络，用于在联合部队中传输大量军事数据；天基机载移动目标指示器计划是 SpaceX 领导的另一个星座，旨在从轨道跟踪飞机和其他机载目标。

SpaceX 此前获得了价值 22.9 亿美元的空间数据网络骨干合同和 41.6 亿美元的机载移动目标指示器系统合同。

此次发射合同是国家安全太空发射第 3 阶段第 1 阶段公开披露的最大订单，该项目是太空军针对低风险国家安全任务的商业式采购计划，允许经过资格预审的供应商在不完成军方最严格的认证流程的情况下竞争单个发射订单。

该合同还遵循太空部队本月早些时候决定将第 3 阶段第 1 阶段合同上限从 56 亿美元提高到 170 亿美元，反映出军事发射需求增长速度将大大快于最初预期的预期。

时间表本身值得注意。 到 2027 年底完成 18 次发射将需要一场持续的活动，范登堡平均每月大约发射一次任务，具体取决于卫星交付的时间。

这种节奏也突显了有资格竞争国家安全发射的公司数量与目前有能力执行这些发射的公司数量之间的差距。

目前有七家公司持有 Lane 1 合约工具。 目前，SpaceX 仍然是唯一一家同时拥有支持如此规模活动所需的发射频率、可运行的猎鹰 9 号火箭和西海岸基础设施的公司。

上校 太空军负责太空访问的代理投资组合采购主管埃里克·扎里布尼斯基 (Eric Zarybnisky) 表示，这些合同还表明了“1 号车道”承包方法的进展速度有多快。 他表示，从确定需求到授予合同，该服务在大约两个月内完成了采购，其中包括行业准备提案的一个月。
